title: Front squat vs back squat: which is better? 🏋️
caption:
In one study the front squat worked the muscles about as hard as the back squat, with less compression on the knees (lifters also used less weight). Upright torso, elbows high, sit between your heels. Front or back? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 12
first_comment: Front squat wrist pain is a rite of passage. Agree? 😅
sources: Gullett JC et al. A biomechanical comparison of back and front squats in healthy trained individuals. J Strength Cond Res 2009;23:284-292
Yavuz HU et al. Kinematic and EMG activities during front and back squat variations in maximum loads. J Sports Sci 2015;33:1058-1066
Haff GG, Triplett NT (eds). Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning, 4th ed. NSCA 2016 (front squat technique)
